title: add-downgrade-guard-version-pinning-backup-restore-schema-migrations-private-installer
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add downgrade guard and version pinning for Private installer; include backup/restore helpers and stricter schema migration ordering. No user-facing API changes; recommended upgrade procedure documented.
description: Motivation: Private deployments require stronger upgrade/rollback guarantees to avoid data loss during automated upgrades. This PR adds a downgrade guard, stricter version pinning, and integrated backup/restore hooks plus ordered schema migrations to the private-installer toolchain. Summary: 1) Add cluster-level downgrade guard that prevents applying manifests when detected component versions would cause incompatible schema downgrades. 2) Introduce a version pinning manifest and validation step in the Helm chart and Terraform module to ensure only allowed target versions are used for upgrades. 3) Add pre-upgrade backup and post-failure restore hooks and a small restoration CLI wrapper for on-prem operators. 4) Introduce ordered Postgres schema migration steps and guard rails to ensure migrations are reversible or blocked when downgrades are attempted. 5) Update docs and runbook with step-by-step upgrade/rollback instructions. Commits: - feat(installer): add downgrade guard controller and tests - chore(installer): pin component versions and validate on apply - feat(backup): add backup/restore scripts and CLI wrapper - feat(migrations): ordered Postgres migrations and reverse-checks - docs: upgrade/rollback runbook and helm usage examples Changed areas (high level): redwood-private-installer/helm/Chart.yaml, redwood-private-installer/helm/values.schema.json, redwood-private-installer/helm/templates/upgrade-hooks.yaml, redwood-private-installer/scripts/backup-restore.sh, redwood-private-installer/tools/restore-cli/main.go, redwood-private-installer/terraform/modules/postgres/migration.tf, redwood-private-installer/docs/upgrade.md, redwood/infra/upgrade-guard/rollout-controller.go, redwood/infra/upgrade-guard/README.md, tests/e2e/private-installer/upgrade_flow_test.go. Tests and CI: unit tests added for downgrade guard controller and for version validation; e2e private-installer upgrade-flow tests updated to exercise backup and restore paths. CI summary: build passed, unit tests passed, e2e private-installer suite passed on the second run after a flakey network-related failure on first run. Rollout plan: merge to main, ship patch release for private-installer chart, notify SREs and key customers with scheduled maintenance windows. Backout: restore CLI and backup artifacts validated on test clusters; rollback documented in docs/upgrade.md. Linear/Jira: ENG-4923 tracks controller work; SUP-1284 a customer support case that motivated backup automation. Notes: This PR is intentionally conservative about automatic rollbacks; automatic downgrades remain disabled unless explicit operator opt-in is provided.
